comment: Advisories accepted for the npm audit gate (scripts/npm_audit_gate.py). Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails the gate so it gets reviewed again.

accepted.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested brace patterns. No patched release exists (<= 3.0.3, first_patched_version null).
